_about: Open models the Eval (self-hosted) workflow can serve with llama.cpp on a GitHub CPU runner. `pattern` picks one GGUF file in the Hugging Face repo; the exact commit and SHA-256 are recorded in every run's summary.json.

qwen3-4b-instruct.notes: Qwen3 4B Instruct (2507), the non-thinking variant: answers without a long hidden reasoning phase.

llama-3.1-8b-instruct.notes: Slower on CPU (about twice the 4B models' time per case).
